package.name: f1tenth_behavior
package.description: py_trees-based reactive safety-stop (obstacle corridor check onto the ackermann_mux) plus Nav2 waypoint navigation (NavigateThroughPoses), for the F1TENTH stack. Guarded behind stack_bringup's use_behavior_tree arg, mutually exclusive with mpc_controller's direct drive-command path. Depends on f1tenth_navigation's nav2_bringup.launch.py already being up (that package now owns all Nav2 node bring-up).
